title: AudioChunk v1
description: Fact: a few seconds of one participant's audio (Opus packets exactly as the browser sent them). Published by the media-relay pod that owns the call; audit-vault encrypts it (AES-256-GCM) and stores it in S3. Delivery is best effort: chunks wait in memory while the broker is down and are dropped (and counted) when the buffer is full, so recording never delays the call. Channel: SQS audio-chunks (media-relay -> audit-vault).

startMs.description: Unix ms of the first frame, on the relay pod's clock. Orders the chunks of one participant.
